summary: Best Day Ever is the fifth mixtape by American rapper Mac Miller, released online on March 11, 2011. Over 20,000 viewers joined Miller for a live video stream just before the release. The mixtape contains 16 songs produced by nine producers, predominantly ID Labs.
one_line: Best Day Ever is Mac Miller's fifth mixtape, released online in March 2011 with 16 songs mostly produced by ID Labs.
key_facts: Best Day Ever is the fifth mixtape by American rapper Mac Miller.
Best Day Ever was released online on March 11, 2011.
Over 20,000 viewers joined Mac Miller for a live video stream just prior to the release of Best Day Ever.
Best Day Ever consists of 16 songs.
The songs on Best Day Ever were produced by nine producers.
ID Labs was the predominant producer of Best Day Ever.
